stem: Naveen compares an iron nail with an aluminium strip. He also sees brown paint on an iron gate and studies rusting in air and water. Which claim is correct?

options.text: Iron rusts when it contacts both air and water.
Aluminium develops brown rust in air and water.
Brown paint on iron is rust.

teacher.key_rationale: Rusting of iron needs both air and water. Dry air alone is not enough. Aluminium does not form the same brown rust. Brown paint is a coating, not rust.
